title: NIST red-teaming raises agent hijacking success to 81% on Claude 3.5 Sonnet
publisher: NIST (Center for AI Standards and Innovation)
summary: Technical staff at NIST's Center for AI Standards and Innovation evaluated agents built on Anthropic's upgraded Claude 3.5 Sonnet with the open-source AgentDojo framework in Workspace, Travel, Slack and Banking environments, adding new injection tasks for remote code execution, database exfiltration and automated phishing. Red-teaming with the UK AI Security Institute raised the attack success rate from 11% for the strongest baseline attack to 81% for the strongest new attack, and running each attack 25 times raised the average success rate across five injection tasks from 57% to 80%.
